note: Every artifact Reivesti has certified against, including those whose bytes no longer exist. Git pins the expectation; `df artifacts catalog` reconciles it against the workspace and the durable store. States: DURABLE, EPHEMERAL_ONLY, MISSING_BYTES, REACQUIRABLE (exact bytes gone; the publisher still serves them, proven only by an equal sha256 on re-download), REGENERABLE (derived; rebuildable from a raw artifact), LOST_EXACT_BYTES (gone; the digest remains as evidence of what was certified).
